notes:
## New features & enhancements

- The radio keeps itself up to date on Windows: the launcher looks at each start and fetches a new version in the background while you listen.
- Clicking the update notice opens a dialog that says whether the new version is already on this machine, and offers to close the radio when it is.
- `Win - Automatic Updates.cmd off` stops the radio updating itself; with no argument it starts again.
- The shortcut button in the top bar hides itself once a Desktop shortcut exists, and the same action is now permanent in Settings - Service.
- Uninstalling removes any registry key belonging to this app; installing clears a dead start-up entry or protocol key.
- The update line reports rather than instructs, and no longer offers a download that costs two security prompts.

## Bug fixes

- The console readout is sharp again: each character carried the full glow, so every cell was washed over by its neighbours.
- The launcher was replaced by its own update while running, and stopped without finishing.
- Two open radios both updated, because the lock was read inside a block that expanded it too early.
- An unattended update could fetch an older installer and stop at a prompt in a console nobody could see.
- A hidden shortcut button was still drawn, the third element to need the same line.
